elements.description: Mathematical formula from Box 1.2 (FGT class of indicators): FGT_α = (1/N) Σ_{i=1}^{H} ((z − y_i)/z)^α, where the summation index runs from i=1 to H, z is the poverty line, and y_i is household i's consumption or income.
